nodes.label: Standalone PHP host installation

nodes.rationale: Never clear customer data after a partial SQL installation; fix the error and retry with a fresh empty database.

nodes.description: An identity with multiple branches/shops gets minimal authorized contexts and no default actor; it must choose an allowed branchId. Foreign, duplicate, forged, inactive or suspended contexts fail closed; central managers do not select a branch.

nodes.description: Matching idempotency key and payload replays without writes; changed payload conflicts, and uniqueness failures qualify as replay only after complete readback matching.
nodes.rationale: Retry must preserve one receipt and must never turn a different request into a successful replay.

nodes.description: One D1 batch allocates the receipt sequence and inserts case, workflow, stage/case events and audit for an existing customer/device; the receipt is derived inside SQL. The authority guard is rechecked within the batch.
nodes.rationale: No application-side statement result can safely substitute for the atomic sequence, and revoked authority must roll back every effect.
